opus.problem: Numbers 15:32 says only that the man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath. The stoning is in Numbers 15:36, so the clue is not fully supported by its cited verse.
Mark 2:24 records only the Pharisees' complaint. The disciples picking heads of grain in the fields is in Mark 2:23, so the clue is not fully supported by its cited verse.
Luke 13:14 does not mention the woman or her eighteen years bent over. Those details are in Luke 13:11, so the clue is not fully supported by its cited verse.
The clue nearly quotes the well-known commandment 'Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy', so it gives the word away on its own rather than being medium hard.
